run_monodepth_depth_maps: run the monodepth CLI to compute depth maps for images in an input folder
run_dpt_hybrid_model: run the DPT-Hybrid model to generate depth predictions from a folder of images
run_dpt_large_model: run the DPT-Large model with vitl16_384 backbone to compute depth maps
run_kitti_crop_depth: run monodepth with KITTI crop mode to process images with 1216x352 cropping
run_midas_v21_depth: run the MidasNet v2.1 convolutional model to compute depth maps for input images
